description: Java class CustomerOptionEntity extending CustomerOption, implements Serializable, representing customer attribute options with additional properties such as order, code, and type.

classes.name: CustomerOptionEntity
classes.description: Represents a customer option attribute with properties for order, code, and type, extending CustomerOption and implementing Serializable.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the order of the customer option.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order of the customer option.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code associated with the customer option.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code of the customer option.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of customer option (e.g., TEXT, SELECT, RADIO, CHECKBOX).

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of customer option.
